with open('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod42/projects/clkc_mech_interp/logs/workers/worker_code_sync-compile-pdf_20260525T201330_result.json') as f:

        continue
    try:
        obj = json.loads(line)
        t = obj.get('type', 'unknown')
        types[t] = types.get(t, 0) + 1
    except:
        types['parse_error'] = types.get('parse_error', 0) + 1
